results.subject: As of September 21, securities of 48 titles will be included in T+ List and T+ Collateral List
ANNOUNCEMENT: On September 18, ForteBank JSC will hold an investor call regarding its performance results for the first half of 2026
results.body:
/KASE, September 15, 2026/ – ForteBank JSC (KASE ticker – ASBN) has 
announced the following:

quote

ForteBank JSC is pleased to invite you to join to its investor call to discuss
the  Bank's financial results for the first half of 2026.

The Bank will release its financial results on September 18, 2026 at 4-00 p.m. 
Astana time / 12-00 p.m. London time, which will be available at: 
https://ir.forte.kz/investors/investor-call

During the call, members of the Bank's senior management will present the 
financial and operating results, provide an update on recent developments, and 
be available to answer questions.

Date: Friday, September 18, 2026

Time: 6-00 p.m. Astana time / 2-00 p.m. London time

Format: Conference call (Zoom)

unquote

The full version of the press release is available in Kazakh, Russian, and
English  – https://kase.kz/files/emitters/ASBN/asbn_relizs_150926_-1.pdf

results.subject: ForteBank JSC reported upgrade of the bank's ratings by Moody's Ratings, outlook is Stable
results.body:
/KASE, July 24, 2026/ – ForteBank JSC (KASE ticker – ASBN) reported the 
following:

beginning of quote

The international rating agency Moody's Ratings has upgraded ForteBank's long-
term deposit ratings in national and foreign currencies from Ba2 to Ba1, and
also  improved the bank's baseline credit assessment (BCA) from ba3 to ba2, with
Stable outlook.

Moody's decision reflects ForteBank's strengthening financial stability and the 
bank's ability to maintain credit metrics while implementing the strategically 
important acquisition of Home Credit Bank.

Moody's report also notes ForteBank's successful management of risks 
associated with integration of the acquired Home Credit Bank, as well as the 
Bank's increased business diversification through expansion of its retail
business  and increase of its client base.

end of quote

Full version of the press release in Kazakh, Russian and English is available at
https://kase.kz/files/emitters/ASBN/asbn_relizs_230726_1.pdf

results.subject: ForteBank JSC strengthens its international funding: a new syndicated loan amounted to $300 mln
results.body:
/KASE, June 25, 2026/ – ForteBank JSC (KASE ticker – ASBN) reported the following:

quote

ForteBank has secured a new syndicated loan in the amount of USD 300 million 
with a two-year tenor. Compared with its previous transaction, the bank has 
nearly doubled the volume of funding raised while also extending the loan's 
maturity to two years. The facility will support the financing of projects in
the real  sector of Kazakhstan's economy, further strengthening the Bank’s
contribution to  sustainable economic growth.

The facility was arranged and bookrun by Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank PJSC, 
AKA Ausfuhrkredit-Gesellschaft mbH, Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, 
Deutsche Bank AG, First Abu Dhabi Bank PJSC and Mashreqbank PSC.

The successful execution of the transaction underscores ForteBank's continued 
access to international funding markets and reflects the strong confidence of 
global financial institutions in the Bank’s credit profile and long-term
strategy. The  facility follows a series of landmark capital markets
transactions completed by  ForteBank, including its inaugural USD 400 million
five-year Eurobond issuance  in February 2025 and the debut USD 400 million AT1
perpetual bond issued in  October 2025.

unquote

The full version of the press release in Kazakh, Russian and English is
available  at – https://kase.kz/files/emitters/ASBN/asbn_relizs_250626_1.pdf

[2026-06-25]

results.subject: ForteBank increases its capital by KZT 46.1 bn to expand business lending
results.body:
/KASE, June 24, 2026/ – ForteBank JSC (KASE ticker: ASBN) reported the 
following:

quote

ForteBank JSC has increased its charter capital by KZT 46.1 billion. Following 
the additional share issuance, the Bank's capital exceeded KZT 890 billion, 
significantly enhancing its capacity to finance Kazakhstan's real sector
economy.

In 2025, ForteBank's total assets grew by 49% to KZT 6.1 trillion. During the 
year, the Bank completed the acquisition of Home Credit Bank JSC, issued 
Kazakhstan's first-ever perpetual subordinated AT1 bonds totaling USD 400 
million, and secured several major international funding transactions in the 
capital markets.

As part of its long-term strategy, ForteBank's shareholders decided to retain
all  2025 earnings to further strengthen the Bank's capital base. The additional
capital increase will support future growth, expand lending capacity and
reinforce  ForteBank's position in the market.

unquote

The full version of the press release in Kazakh, Russian and English is
available  at – https://kase.kz/files/emitters/ASBN/asbn_relizs_240626_1.pdf
